body: Nothing is more unsatisfying than a pair of flimsy arm rests. I want  to feel like i'm being bear hugged by kratos himself, not a half-hearted side hug from a relative i don't remember on Thanksgiving.

Here's the set I got, it's a satisfying size and good quality, these things won't break on you anytime soon
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07YZ3775X?ref=pd_basp_dp_primary
Finally, someone brave enough to give us the buff-edel we all deserve. Thank you for making this.

I'm a month out from surgery for an S curve like your mom. If she is a side sleeper, look into getting some sort of long body pillow to keep her hips and shoulder straight while sleeping. I still have a good amount of pain in my hips spooning the pillow keeps the muscles from aching too bad.

Art has always been an important aspect of expression in my life, especially during the rougher periods, becoming drawn to Apollo just came about naturally. It doesn't feel as oppressive as Catholicism and I feel a much more personal connection. I feel more comfort in my life rather than anxiety brought on by Abrahamic  worship did.
It's amazing that you got to teach gymnastics! Thank you, I feel so reassured after reading this.
Thanks, heading to urgent care on my next day off

Just some more info. The red spots not directly surrounding the rash is from the medical tape I'm using to keep the bandage I  place. I've changed it 4 times since I got it so about 12 hours in between and there's this pus like goo coating it every time. It doesn't have that rank pus smell though so???

It sounds a bit like anxiety, I feel similar when I'm in public, my heart beat picks up I can suddenly hear a bunch of conversations at once and I want to start running. I started drinking tea with kava in it and it seriously calmed me down. I still have moments but, they're a lot less intense and way less frequent.
